content.title: Justin Bieber Serenades Superfan Billie Eilish and Duets with SZA During Coachella Weekend 2
content.text: Sexyy Red and Big Sean also made surprise guest appearances during the pop star's April 18 performance Published on April 19, 2026 07:39AM EDT SZA (left) and Justin Bieber performing at Coachella on April 19, Justin Bieber (left) and Billie Eilish (right) performing at Coachella on April 19. Credit : Coachella/Youtube NEED TO KNOW Justin Bieber took the stage at Coachella for his second performance on Saturday, April 18He sweetly serenaded superfan Billie Eilish at one point and later performed a duet with SZASexyy Red and Big Sean also made surprise guest appearances during the pop star's Indio, Calif., performance Justin Bieber has once again caused major Bieber-fever at Coachella. On Saturday, April 18, the "Daises" singer, 32, took the stage for his second headlining performance in Indio, Calif. He was joined by an array of special guests — including Billie Eilish, a self-proclaimed super fan, who joined Bieber onstage for “One Less Lonely Girl," and SZA, who sang “Snooze” with the pop star. Justin Bieber performing at Coachella on April 19. Coachella/Youtube Sexyy Red and Big Sean also made surprise appearances during Bieber's April 18 performance. Red, 28, joined Bieber for a duet of their song “Sweet Spot," while Sean, 38, appeared to perform “As Long As You Love Me” and “No Pressure" with the father of one. Justin Bieber (left) and Big Sean (right) Justin Bieber performing at Coachella on April 19, Sexyy Redd (left) and Justin Bieber (right) performing at Coachella on April 19. Coachella/Youtube Bieber debuted his headlining performance at Coachella on April 11 — and there was a mixed reaction to his minimalistic set. During the set, Bieber played songs from his latest albums SWAG and SWAG II, as well as snippets of hits from throughout his career. After the performance, a source told PEOPLE that he wasn't concerned with the reactions. "He felt great about the set. He was excited to reconnect with fans in a way that felt true to where he is now," said the source. "He's not focused on how it's being labeled. He wanted to show up and do it his way. And that's exactly what he did. He's happy with how it turned out." Justin Bieber performing at Coachella on April 19. In addition to performing solo, Bieber surprised the crowd with an appearance from The Kid LAROI, as well as Dijon, Tems, WizKid and Mk.gee. At the time, he also gave a sweet shout-out to wife Hailey Bieber — who was watching from the audience — as he sang "Everything Hallelujah." During the song, he sang, "Hailey, babe, hallelujah." He also included their son, "Baby Jack, hallelujah." Related Stories The PEOPLE Puzzler crossword is here! How quickly can you solve it? Play now! In March, the "Yukon" singer held a surprise invite-only show at The Roxy Theatre in Los Angeles, and the setlist featured songs from SWAG and SWAG II. In the past, Bieber made surprise appearances at Coachella with Ariana Grande in 2019 and with Tems in 2024.
